notes: Hangar, attic and Port crane keys can all roll from the Keys fuse recipe (Monolith level Delta, 300 Monolith Tokens): one cassette (Space Work Universe, Black Iron, Driving Home, Back Again or Blackmail) + one Accumulator battery, Damaged ammo or Fuse. The output key is random.

keys.opens: Door of the port crane inside the gravity anomaly; leads to the Weapon Barge route
keys.found: Cargo Port, inside the gravity anomaly area (exact spawn unconfirmed)
keys.craft: Keys fuse recipe (Monolith Delta), random output
keys.loot: Hidden equipment stash; players report PKM, VAL, SVD from the Weapon Barge
